title: add representative workload runners and reporting pipeline v9
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: improve representative workload coverage for the benchmark lab and consolidate reporting into a single pipeline that produces nightly baselines and profiling artifacts. This PR adds a set of workload runners that mirror common customer patterns (short-chat, long-context summarization, embedding-heavy batch workloads), standardizes CSV+parquet reporting, and wires results into the existing reporting pipeline with versioned baselines. Changes include runner harnesses, new perf metrics (p50/p95/p99 token latency, batching efficiency), profiling baseline artifacts (torchprof traces, kernel selection logs), and a reporting job that uploads artifacts to s3 and updates the baseline index. Checklist: - [x] add representative workload runners (short-chat, long-context, embeddings-batch) - [x] profile baseline collection + artifact format - [x] add reporting pipeline job + upload step - [x] add unit/integration tests for runner harness - [x] update docs and quickstart examples - [x] run regression tests across the runtime matrix Notes: this is v9 of the runner set (iterating on runner parametrization and trace fidelity). The reporting job is configurable via environment variables (S3_BUCKET, BASELINE_PREFIX, KEEP_ARTIFACTS_DAYS). Linear links: ENG-4128 (primary), ENG-4199 (follow-on for dashboarding). Related: previous iterations are v7/v8 PRs in this repo (see history).
commits_summary: 3 commits: 1) add workload runner harness and config templates; 2) add profiler collectors and baseline serializer; 3) wire reporting pipeline job and tests. All commits are squashed at merge.
review_conversation: Ethan Brooks: Nice work — can you add the batching efficiency metric as a ratio instead of an absolute token count? It will be easier to compare across runs.
Ava Martinez: Good point. I added batching_efficiency as tokens_per_gpu_second and normalized in the serializer. See benchmarks/profiler/serializers.py commit.
Priya Nair: CI failed on the long-context runner with OOM on the smallest test machine. Can we reduce the default batch_size for that runner and make it configurable?
Ava Martinez: Reduced default batch_size to 1 for long_context_runner and added a MAX_SEQ env var to guard memory. Added unit test covering the small-machine config.
Samir Patel: Left a small nit in upload.py about retry backoff; otherwise verified artifacts upload and baseline index update locally.
Ava Martinez: Addressed retry backoff and added exponential backoff with cap, plus test for transient S3 failures. Thanks for the review — squashed and ready to merge.
Ethan Brooks: Approved after re-run of perf CI; p95 regression within tolerance.
CI Bot: All checks green after rerun (build, unit tests, perf-regression).
release_notes: Add representative workload runners (short-chat, long-context, embeddings-batch) and nightly reporting pipeline: generates profiled baselines and uploads artifacts to S3 for downstream dashboards and regression tracking.
notes: This PR updates the baseline format; downstream dashboards must read the new parquet schema. Owners: benchmark-lab team. Backwards compatibility: readers that expect the old CSV summary will be supported for two weeks via a compatibility layer in the reporting job.
